# Upstream provenance

This directory vendors the Apache-2.0 `lib` source from Hammerhead's official
`karoo-ext` tag `1.1.9`, commit `26e1d1c5c86e4d49922b2e2cc0474e62fc3b6eed`.

Source: <https://github.com/hammerheadnav/karoo-ext/tree/1.1.9/lib>

It is built as a local Android library so a clean checkout remains reproducible without
placing a personal GitHub Packages token in developer or CI configuration.
